title: Page 108
transc:
HdQrs Dec 9 ' 1015 AM
For Abel You will notice that
my orders of last night differed
from the plan sent you before
in moving Atlas by way of
Centreville instead of Warrenton I made
this change because it seems to
be the shortest way to join
the of this Taunton where it 
will be used for keeping open
communication & be cause of the
danger of his column being caught
by bad weather on the roads
short of supplies On the present
route he will all the time
be where he can supply him
self from some of the depots
in Daniel or Mohawk or by
the Scotland soon after Gertrude today
I will send a messenger to
you with definite plan of operations
Adverb Laura fifteen past pleasant morning
